author: Ortea, Espinosa & Moro, 2001

note.en: A bubble snail of about 3 mm, known here only from two preserved specimens taken at 9 m and 25 m near Punta Mona and Manzanillo in 2001 and 2002.
note.es: Una babosa burbuja de unos 3 mm, conocida aquí solo por dos ejemplares preservados tomados a 9 m y 25 m cerca de Punta Mona y Manzanillo en 2001 y 2002.

evidence: GBIF: 2 preserved specimens in the region (INBio Atta collection, 2001 and 2002)
WoRMS lists it for the Costa Rican Caribbean and Cuba

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records (INBio Atta specimen collection), Gandoca to Limón

recWhy: Recorded: GBIF: 2 preserved specimens in the region (INBio Atta collection, 2001 and 2002).

marks.en: Small white bubble snail with a thin, mostly hidden shell and a soft, smooth body.
marks.es: Caracol burbuja blanco y pequeño con concha delgada casi oculta y cuerpo blando y liso.
